title: Unit 2 Consolidation: Memory, Nostalgia & Sensory Description

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can recognize and parse left-branching -ó/-ő and -t/-tt participial clauses in literary Hungarian.
I can recall B2 sensory and nostalgic vocabulary from Krúdy's 'A vörös postakocsi'.
I can compress relative clauses into idiomatic pre-nominal participial phrases.
